random_track: Date-grouped exploratory benchmark. Candidate models ranked by validation macro-F1; selected model refit on train+validation and evaluated on held-out test.
chronological_track: Diagnostic only. No model selection from chronological validation because class coverage may be incomplete.
target_limitation: water_stress_rule_derived is generated by the simulator and is not independent field-observed ground truth.
intervention_feature_limitation: For next-day prediction, irrigation litres are from input day t. They are valid only if known at prediction time.
